findings.body:
**Forward the wiring `cqEnv` to the analyze driver factories.**

Both analyze driver factories receive only `onDeprecatedAlias`. They do not receive `wiring.cqEnv`. The factory reads the session-log switch from `config.cqEnv ?? currentCqEnv()`. Outside an enclosing run, `currentCqEnv()` falls back to a fresh ambient read. A `CQ_SESSION_LOGS=off` value that the host supplies only through `wiring.cqEnv` is therefore ignored. The agentic remediation request sets no `sessionRetention`, so retention resolves to `'keep'` and session records are kept. The fix, merge, and review registries forward `wiring.cqEnv`, so the analyze registry is inconsistent with them.

Forward `cqEnv` at both factory sites:

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
             drivers: createDriverFactory(
-              wiring?.onDeprecatedAlias !== undefined
-                ? { onDeprecatedAlias: wiring.onDeprecatedAlias }
-                : {},
+              {
+                ...(wiring?.onDeprecatedAlias !== undefined
+                  ? { onDeprecatedAlias: wiring.onDeprecatedAlias }
+                  : {}),
+                ...(wiring?.cqEnv !== undefined ? { cqEnv: wiring.cqEnv } : {}),
+              },
             ),
```

```diff
           m.makeAgenticRemediation(
             createDriverFactory(
-              wiring?.onDeprecatedAlias !== undefined
-                ? { onDeprecatedAlias: wiring.onDeprecatedAlias }
-                : {},
+              {
+                ...(wiring?.onDeprecatedAlias !== undefined
+                  ? { onDeprecatedAlias: wiring.onDeprecatedAlias }
+                  : {}),
+                ...(wiring?.cqEnv !== undefined ? { cqEnv: wiring.cqEnv } : {}),
+              },
             ),
```

</details>
findings.title: Forward the wiring `cqEnv` to the analyze driver factories.
